description: FORECAST_SECONDARIES (AIForecast port of the Combat Calc forecast): the active player holds Bring It Down while every enemy W10+ model is dead, plus No Prisoners. In the Scoring phase the AI suggestion prices each card by its VP over the rest of the battle: Bring It Down is worth ~0 VP, less than the CP a discard gains, so it is discarded for +1 CP; No Prisoners is kept. The K panel shows the forecast terms in player words, and the discard really happens (card gone, CP +1).

steps.script:
var mgr = SecondaryMissionManager
var p = GameState.get_active_player()
var opp = 2 if p == 1 else 1
Engine.set_meta("fc_player", p)
GameState.state["meta"]["game_config"]["player1_type"] = "HUMAN"
GameState.state["meta"]["game_config"]["player2_type"] = "HUMAN"
GameState.state["meta"]["battle_round"] = 2
for k in [p, opp]:
	if not mgr.is_initialized(k):
		mgr.setup_tactical_deck(k)
	mgr._player_state[str(k)]["mode"] = "tactical"
	mgr._player_state[str(k)]["active"] = []
var st = mgr._player_state[str(p)]
for mid in ["bring_it_down", "no_prisoners"]:
	st["deck"].erase(mid)
	st["active"].append(mgr._create_active_mission(SecondaryMissionData.get_mission_by_id(mid)))
var killed = 0
for uid in GameState.state["units"].keys():
	var u = GameState.state["units"][uid]
	if int(u.get("owner", 0)) != opp:
		continue
	for m in u.get("models", []):
		if int(m.get("wounds", u.get("meta", {}).get("stats", {}).get("wounds", 1))) >= 10 and m.get("alive", true):
			m["alive"] = false
			killed += 1
GameState.state["players"][str(p)]["bonus_cp_gained_this_round"] = 0
AIDecisionMaker._config_overrides["FORECAST_SECONDARIES"] = 1.0
return "p=%d killed_w10=%d hand=%s" % [p, killed, str(st["active"].map(func(m): return m["id"]))]
steps.comment: Setup: Bring It Down + No Prisoners in hand, every enemy W10+ model dead, forecast secondaries on

steps.script: main._ai_suggestion_panel.breakdown_text.contains("CP gained in VP") and main._ai_suggestion_panel.breakdown_text.contains("over the rest of the battle") and main._ai_suggestion_panel.breakdown_text.contains("Discard 'No Prisoners'")

steps.comment: No Prisoners is kept; the round's bonus CP is used, so nothing else is discarded
